scope: Read-only source review while original v34 crash build remains frozen at57e1fb3d. No new transport/decoder run or pass inferred.

sources.finding: Public replacement intent selects endpoint/candidate and retained connection; it has no typed video-preservation field.
Managed Core replacement plan carries audio publication/selection state; the reviewed plan builds SavedAudioProgram mappings.
Unmixed routing binds exact source controller, logical stream and receiver stream. Audio program copying alone cannot establish the new video receive routes.
Target negotiated resources are muted before private readiness; full resource presence is not ordinary video readiness.
The peer invokes video controls only after observing completed original root, and opens video after controls return.

sources.anchor: // Every publication was muted during resource preparation. Preserve Data
sources.finding: The late unmute also opens Data publications, and the subscription batch includes audio, video and optional Data. Video staging must preserve separate Data authority and reliable delivery semantics.
The source consumes the original preencoded programme; first video publication waits for a future original keyframe. This loop has no live encoder/request-to-keyframe path.
The complete fixture VP8 programme is encoded ahead of time at500kbit/s,1Mbit/s maximum,GOP30. Feedback needs a request-capable source while retaining this profile and its original clock.
The observer uses a locally observed root completion time as an ownership cut. Video staging must be paired with authenticated epoch attribution rather than moving that cut to an arbitrary timestamp.

implementation_order: Add explicit typed video-transfer intent and immutable source/target stream mapping. Preserve old mute/selection intent only under fresh complete operator, source and target authorization and accepted capabilities; negotiate incoming video resources while ordinary target media remains closed.

Extend the managed Core replacement preparation/commit beyond SavedAudioProgram to the exact video publication gates and direct-subscription mappings. Publish their actual resource revisions with the existing activation barrier. Keep Data publication/subscription and reliable writer/exchange requirements distinct; do not infer Data transfer permission from video intent.

Add bounded, current-authorized keyframe feedback and a request-capable source that encodes a fresh eligible frame using the original programme clock. Reusing the next periodic keyframe from the current immutable vector does not implement request-driven bootstrap. Bind the new receiver history to its authenticated connection/generation/stream epoch before changing verifier ownership cuts.
constraints: No weakening of original dimensions, codec, bitrate, GOP maximum, packet age, frame limits, quality coverage or four-move schedule.
No all-intra substitution, stale keyframe replay, cross-device decoder-state reuse or resetting original source timestamps.
No broad/full media rerun until focused activation/bootstrap/epoch evidence exists. G054 remains deferred.
